_meta.feast: The Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste
_meta._note: OCA does not publish a Matins DOCX for this feast. Matins from St-Sergius Emenaion (yy/archaic register). Two canons both in Tone II: Canon I by John the Monk (acrostic 'I hymn the divinely-crowned company of martyrs'); Canon II by Theophanes (acrostic 'I hymn the divinely-crowned regiment of martyrs'). Falls during Great Lent — sessional hymns reflect the Saturday-of-Lent variant from the Sergius PDF. When Mar 9 lands on a Lenten weekday, parish practice typically transfers the festal Matins to the nearest Saturday or anticipates with First Hour. Magnificat retained. Single-tone two-canon (both Tone II); the two Tone-II irmoi are identical for some odes.

troparion.text:
By the pangs which Thy saints, suffered for Thee,
hearken unto us, O Lord,
and heal all our diseases,//
we beseech Thee, O Lover of mankind.
troparion.label: Troparion of the holy martyrs

kontakion.text:
Having fully left the army of the world,
ye cleaved unto the Master in the heavens,
O forty passion-bearers of the Lord;
for, having passed through fire and water,
O blessed ones,
ye received glory from the heavens as is meet//
and a multitude of crowns.
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy martyrs

sedalion.text:
O ye forty divine martyrs of Christ,
like the greatest of stars ye ever illumine the honorable firmament of the Church
and enlighten the faithful.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 1)
sedalion._note: Sung twice (Saturday-of-Lent variant per Sergius; on a Lenten weekday the K1 + K2 sessional hymns come from the Triodion).

bothNow.text:
Accepting the entreaty of us
who have recourse to thy protection, O Virgin,
cease thou never to make supplication to Him
Who is the Lover of mankind,//
that He save thy servants.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

sedalion.text:
O wondrous passion-bearers, passing over torment with most manly intent,
ye passed through fire and water,
and crossed over to the wide spaces of salvation,
receiving the Kingdom of Heaven as an inheritance.
Wherein do ye make divine supplication on our behalf,
O ye wise forty athletes.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 2)

bothNow.text:
O Theotokos and Sovereign Lady, we, thy servants,
thankfully chanting from our hearts and earnestly entreating thy mercies, cry out, saying:
O most holy Virgin, go thou before us
and deliver us from our enemies, visible and invisible,
and from every threat, for thou art our aid.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

magnification.refrain:
We magnify you, O holy passion-bearers,
the forty martyrs of Christ,
and we honor your honorable sufferings.
verses: We went through fire and water, and Thou didst bring us out into refreshment.
Glory… Both now… Alleluia… Glory to thee, O God!

sessionalHymns.text:
Adornment of the holy martyrs! Lo! the divinely assembled company of the forty warriors of four-fold radiance!
Tried by fire and intense cold, the wise ones were truly revealed to be soldiers of Christ, the King of all,
entreating Him that we be saved.
sessionalHymns.label: Sessional Hymn after the Polyeleios

bothNow.text:
I weep now before the Judgment, O pure one,
mindful of my wicked and evil deeds,
of the abyss of my transgressions which hath grown from my youth,
stifling my mind.
But by their intercession grant me forgiveness,
and grant that I obtain salvation.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

prokeimenon.refrain:
We went through fire and water,
and Thou didst bring us out into refreshment.
prokeimenon.verse: Thou tried us even as silver is tried by fire.

gospel._note: Persecution prophesied; 'In your patience possess ye your souls.'

postGospelSticheron.text:
Prophetically David cried aloud in the Psalms:
We went through fire and water, and Thou didst bring us out into refreshment!
And ye, O martyrs of Christ, fulfilling the word in very deed,
passed through fire and water, and entered into the Kingdom of Heaven.
Wherefore, pray, O ye forty athletes,//
that we be granted great mercy.
postGospelSticheron.label: Sticheron after Psalm 50

_authors.first: John the Monk (Canon I, Tone II; acrostic 'I hymn the divinely-crowned company of martyrs')
_authors.second: Theophanes (Canon II, Tone II; acrostic 'I hymn the divinely-crowned regiment of martyrs')

canon._canonNote: Both canons in Tone II; their irmoi are identical for each ode. Katavasiae: 'I shall open my mouth' (the Theotokos canon irmoi).

ode1.irmos:
Come, O ye people, let us sing a song to Christ our God,
Who divided the sea, and made a way for the nation
which He had brought up out of the bondage of Egypt;
for He hath been glorified.
ode1.irmos2:
Come, O ye people, let us sing a song to Christ our God,
Who divided the sea, and made a way for the nation
which He had brought up out of the bondage of Egypt;
for He hath been glorified.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
With hymns inspired by God I praise the divinely-crowned regiment of the martyrs of Christ,
radiantly celebrating the annual commemoration of the forty,
for He hath been glorified!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Rejecting every title on earth, the forty desired the title of Christian,
wherefore they now dwell in the Highest.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Living in Christ and despising the flesh and the world,
ye put off the old man and this transitory vesture,
and clothed yourselves in the garment of incorruption.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Who is able fittingly to recount thy conceiving which surpasseth telling?
For thou, O most pure one, hast given birth in the flesh to God, the Savior of us all,
Who hath revealed Himself unto us.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
By your supplication, O ye forty martyrs,
render God well-disposed towards us who call upon you with the pure love of our hearts.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Enlightened in the heavens with the rays of the splendor of the three-fold Sun,
O ye forty martyrs, protect us who hymn you on earth,
frozen over by the winter of temptations.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O forty martyrs, invincible and unshaken rampart of piety and the Church:
do ye now pacify that which doth grievously trouble the Christian calling.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O Virgin Theotokos, Mother who hath not known a man,
thou hast given birth unto the Creator and Lord Who is supra-naturally over all
and Who, for our sake, took upon Himself our flesh.

ode1.katavasia: I shall open my mouth, and it shall be filled with the Spirit…

ode3.irmos:
O Lord, who didst slay sin upon the tree,
firmly establish us in Thee,
and in the hearts of us who hymn Thee plant the fear of Thee.
ode3.irmos2:
O Lord, who didst slay sin upon the tree,
firmly establish us in Thee,
and in the hearts of us who hymn Thee plant the fear of Thee.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Disdaining the army and life, the comeliness of their bodies and wealth,
the glorious forty martyrs inherited Christ instead of all of these things.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
When the forty martyrs were beaten mercilessly with stones at the command of the tormentors,
through the Spirit of God the stones were hurled back against those who commanded that they be beaten.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The serpent of him who invented blasphemy spake through the lips of the tormentors,
but his God-opposing mouth hath been broken by the rocks hurled against the martyrs.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O ye martyred company and united chorus of crowned martyrs:
standing before the Master, ever save us who sing your praises.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Battered by the lake of the passions and by the waves of grievous temptations,
we flee to you, Christ's forty warriors.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Warmed in the bosom of Abraham and adorned with glorious apparel,
pray ye that Christ grant forgiveness unto those who are bound by the winter of evil circumstances.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O Virgin Bride of God: be thou the confirmation, refuge and protection
of those who have recourse unto thee in faith
and confess thee to be the Mother of God.

sedalenAfterOde3.text:
Having served Christ in martyrdom as warriors, and having cast down the enemy through suffering,
in your deeds ye fulfilled the words of the Prophet:
ye went manfully through fire and water, finding refreshment, and life incorruptible.
Wherefore, adorned with heavenly crowns,
ye rejoice with the choirs of the bodiless ones, O blessed and all-praised passion-bearers.
Entreat Christ God, that He grant forgiveness of sins unto those who honor your holy memory with love.
sedalenAfterOde3.label: Sessional Hymn (after Ode 3)

bothNow.text:
From the snares of enemies visible and invisible,
we have been overcome by the storms of our innumerable sins,
and fleeing unto the safe harbor of thy goodness O pure one,
we have thee as our rampart and sure protection.
Wherefore we thy servants beseech thee
to ceaselessly make fervent supplication, O most pure one,
unto Him who seedlessly became incarnate from thee,
that those who worthily hymn thee//
may be granted the remission of their sins.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

ode4.irmos:
I have heard report of Thy dispensation, O Lord,
and have glorified Thee Who alone lovest mankind.
ode4.irmos2:
I have heard report of Thy dispensation, O Lord,
and have glorified Thee Who alone lovest mankind.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: "O ye most iniquitous ones, ye have been made to vainly offer such a poor bargain!" said the sufferers.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Sharpened swords and wild beasts, fire and the cross
did the tormentors offer to the saints of Christ.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
"The fire of Gehenna is frightful to us, but we are not afraid of any of our fellow servants here present,"
said the athletes.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
"Let our arms be cut off, let our feet be burned," the holy ones cried out,
"for we shall receive them back incorruptible."

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: We beseech thee, O most pure one who didst conceive God without seed:
ever pray for thy servants.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O martyrs, through God ye have become our illumination,
for ye have clothed yourselves in undimmed splendor.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O divinely elect and crowned assembly of martyrs,
pray that those who hymn you be delivered from misfortunes.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O holy ones, having been deemed worthy to behold the unwaning light of Christ,
ye shine forth upon those who sit in darkness.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Shining with the noetic radiance of Christ, O ye glorious ones,
guide us to the divine illumination.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Hymning Him Who was incarnate from thy womb, O pure one,
we glorify thee as the Mother of God.

ode5.irmos:
O Lord, Bestower of light and Creator of the ages:
guide us in the light of Thy commandments,
for we know none other God than Thee.
ode5.irmos2:
O Lord, Bestower of light and Creator of the ages:
guide us in the light of Thy commandments,
for we know none other God than Thee.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Through the most mindless savagery of the tormentors,
the spiritual athletes, condemned to spend the night in the open air in the cold,
chanted a hymn of thanksgiving unto God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Rejoicing, the forty martyrs endured the painful ice, standing in the lake,
yet were strengthened with the hope of divine crowns.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The serpent which before had made its nest in the waters, and now driven out,
became an object of scorn for the forty martyrs of Christ,
for he was deprived of his deadly strength.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: To thee who hast given birth to Christ, the Creator of all, do we cry aloud:
Rejoice, O pure one! Rejoice, thou who hast shone forth the Light upon us!
Rejoice, thou who didst contain the infinite God!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
From the raging of the heretics do ye now deliver the honorable Church of Christ, O forty martyrs;
for, having been born within Her, ye have passed on to great dignity and glory.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Appearing to us, the forty divinely splendid martyrs of Christ
like fiery beacons light the salvific way of piety for the faithful.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Passing over from earth to the shelter of Heaven,
where ye stand before Christ, the Judge of the contest, O martyrs,
deem me worthy to acquire divine joy.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O Maiden Sovereign Lady, thou didst truly bear God as thy divine Offspring,
as a mystery inscrutable and incomprehensible to all,
passing all understanding.

ode6.irmos:
Whirled about in the abyss of sin,
I appeal to the unfathomable abyss of Thy compassion:
Raise me up from corruption, O God.
ode6.irmos2:
Whirled about in the abyss of sin,
I appeal to the unfathomable abyss of Thy compassion:
Raise me up from corruption, O God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
With joy the author of enmity snatched him that fell away from the forty
as did the wretched Judas from the twelve apostles,
and mankind from Eden.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Vain-minded and worthy of lamentation is he who missed both lives,
for thawed by the fire, he departed into the unquenchable flames.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O Virgin, thou hast given birth without knowing a man,
and remainest forever a virgin,
revealing the images of thy Son and God, the true Deity.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O mighty ones, ye have been revealed to be watchful and vigilant preservers of the human race,
offering up supplications, and set forth as helpers of the grieving.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Shining forth in the Church of Christ in your unexcelled beauties, O all-praised ones,
deliver those who honor you with love from all temptations.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Of old ye became destroyers of the deception of the demonized persecutors, O most eminent ones;
and now be our ready help and rampart.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: On thee have I placed my hope of salvation, O Ever-virgin Mother;
and Thee have I appointed as the steadfast and unshakable intercessor of my life.

kontakion.text:
Having fully left the army of the world,
ye cleaved unto the Master in the heavens,
O forty passion-bearers of the Lord;
for, having passed through fire and water,
O blessed ones,
ye received glory from the heavens as is meet//
and a multitude of crowns.
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy martyrs

ikos.text:
Unworthy as I am, I fall down before Christ Almighty, our Creator and God,
Who sitteth upon an unapproachable throne, Who stretched out the heavens as it were a curtain,
Who established the earth, Who gathered the waters in the bodies thereof,
Who created all things out of nothing,
Who granteth breath and life unto all,
Who receiveth hymnody from the archangels,
is worshipped by the angels and is glorified by all;
and offering up entreaty, I beg the grace of eloquence,
that even I may piously hymn the saints whom He Himself showed forth as victors,
granting them glory from the heavens and a multitude of crowns.

ode7.irmos:
When the golden image was worshipped on the plain of Dura,
Thy three children spurned the impious command,
and, cast into the midst of the flame,
they were bedewed, and sang:
O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!
ode7.irmos2:
When the golden image was worshipped on the plain of Dura,
Thy three children spurned the impious command,
and, cast into the midst of the flame,
they were bedewed, and sang:
O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The guard set over the forty martyrs was struck with awe, beholding their crowns;
and, rejecting that which bound him to life,
taking wing with the love of Thy manifest glory,
with the martyrs he sang: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
When the noetic fire flared up in the minds of the forty,
the most subtle madness of the impious was consumed, as it were melting wax.
And to Thee, O Christ, they sang: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: On Mount Sinai Moses foresaw thee, O pure one, as a burning bush
which, without being consumed, bore the unbearable radiance of the ineffable Being,
Who as One of the holy Hypostases, hath united Himself to the coarseness of our flesh.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Your annual commemoration hath radiantly dawned, O ye spiritually rich martyrs,
shining far, radiant with the splendor of the Fast.
And celebrating it with faith, we chant with you:
O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
To all ye have been revealed to be as ones loosened from the passions
and beacons shining from afar, the cleansing of the world,
the destruction of deception, clear-voiced proclaimers of the truth and expellers of falsehood,
chanting: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Beautiful to God and desirable to the angels is the divinely assembled and most splendid regiment of the forty martyrs
inspired by God, the godly and awesome company which crieth out, saying:
O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: A beacon of light, a luminous cloud and a hallowed place hast thou been revealed to be,
O thou who knewest not wedlock, for thou didst ineffably receive the Word, the Holy One of those who are holy.
And chanting unto Him, we cry aloud: O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!

ode8.irmos:
God Who descended into the fiery furnace with the Hebrew children,
and transformed the flame into dew,
do ye works hymn, and supremely exalt as Lord throughout all ages.
ode8.irmos2:
God Who descended into the fiery furnace with the Hebrew children,
and transformed the flame into dew,
do ye works hymn, and supremely exalt as Lord throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Savagely inciting every creature against the athletes,
the enemy hath been put to shame by them all,
for the forty martyrs unceasingly hymn and supremely exalt the Lord throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
"Make thy journey running straight to everlasting life, O my son,"
the Christ-loving mother cried out to her Christ-loving child,
"for I could not bear to see thee appear in second place before Christ, the Judge of the contest!"

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: The Son Who is not parted from the bosom of the Father,
yet made His abode in thy maternal womb, O pure Virgin Bride of God,
do we hymn and supremely exalt throughout all ages!

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Having passed over from earth to the heavens, O crowned spiritual athletes,
ye chorus of victorious martyrs of the Church,
ask for us salvation and deliverance from misfortunes, passions and evil circumstances.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Rending asunder the bonds of death, the Savior hath given victory over death to His martyrs,
for, warmed by the cold, the forty sang, asking for salvation for all the faithful.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Through prayer the divine choir of passion-bearers manifestly drive the assaults of dangers,
the attack of the passions and the temptations of the demons away from those who hymn Christ throughout the ages.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Mortals given over to the dust of mortality and to corruption hast thou alone raised up,
O pure Lady, Virgin Birthgiver of God,
having given birth to Christ our God, the Author of life.

ode9.irmos:
God the Word, God of God,
Who by ineffable wisdom came to create Adam anew
after his grievous fall to corruption through eating
and Who took flesh beyond all telling from the Holy Virgin for our sake,
Him we faithful with one accord magnify in song.
ode9.irmos2:
God the Word, God of God,
Who by ineffable wisdom came to create Adam anew
after his grievous fall to corruption through eating
and Who took flesh beyond all telling from the Holy Virgin for our sake,
Him we faithful with one accord magnify in song.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Stripped naked and beaten with stones for the sake of Christ,
ye endured the wintry air, icy water and crushing of your limbs;
and having been consumed by fire, O ye forty martyrs,
ye shine forth in the rushing river like beacons.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Having acquired the Cross as a staff of divine power,
the forty spiritual athletes cried out to Christ:
O Master, almighty Conqueror, crown us by Thine own hand,
that we all may unceasingly magnify Thee with hymns!

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The pain of the ice and boundless cruelty of the cold did ye endure, O forty martyrs;
but paradise is sweet, for the bosom of the Patriarch Abraham doth warm you in the eternal mansions.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Manifest as conquerors by your sufferings,
and having received crowns from the divine right hand of the Master, O forty martyrs,
pray ye now that peace be granted to the world and victory and salvation to us.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Supra-natural illumination and ineffable joy and glory have ye been deemed worthy to receive;
and now, O soldiers of Christ, ye forty martyrs,
from temptations, misfortunes and the wickedness of the enemy
deliver those who honor you with love.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Having received power and might from the heavens, O ye most noetically rich martyrs,
fellow prisoners of Christ, in that ye have become dispellers of falsehood,
drive away all the ephemeral gloom of idolatry and enlighten the world, O ye forty martyrs.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Adorned with the comeliness of an honorable martyrdom, and sharing in divine life,
O forty martyrs, warriors of Christ, ye truly rejoice,
united to the most radiant and pure Light.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forty Martyrs of Sebaste, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Standing now before Christ with the boldness of piety,
and illumined with the light of the Godhead, O glorious forty martyrs,
earnestly beseech Him, that those who praise you be illumined with the thrice-luminous radiance.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O Virgin, portal of divine Light, with the immaterial rays of thy light
illumine the manifest twilight of my soul,
and grant that I who magnify thee faithfully and lovingly with hymns, O pure one,
be delivered from everlasting fire.

exapostilaria.text:
Let us hymn the company of forty as is meet, the victorious regiment,
the array of the holy martyrs,
for by fire, ice and water they have put to shame the regiments of the adversary
and received crowns of glory from Christ the Savior.
exapostilaria.label: Exaposteilarion of the holy martyrs

exapostilaria.text:
Let the forty-member choir of the forty who were martyred for the supremely divine Trinity
and the four-fold virtues, by the four elements: fire, air, water and earth,
be hymned with divine songs,
for they suffered for Christ, the Master of all.
exapostilaria.label: Another Exaposteilarion (at Glory)

exapostilaria.text:
O Virgin Mother who, though a maiden, hast given birth to the Master of all things and all creation:
rescue me from the passions which torment me,
and lead me to the radiance of thy tender compassion
and to the most beautiful Pascha of thy risen Son.
exapostilaria.label: Theotokion (at Both now)

stichera.verse: To do among them the judgment that is written: this glory shall be to all His saints. (Ps. 149:9)
stichera.text:
Come ye, O brethren, and with praises let us hymn the regiment of martyrs
which was consumed by fire and cold,
and with burning zeal burned up the winter of deception,
the most brave army, the most sanctified company,
the unvanquished and invincible protection,
the rampart and protectors of the faith,
the divine choir of the forty martyrs
who mightily entreat Christ, the Mediator of the Church,//
that He send down upon our souls peace and great mercy.

stichera.verse: Praise God in His saints; praise Him in the firmament of His power. (Ps. 150:1)
Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His exceeding greatness. (Ps. 150:2)
stichera.text:
Rejoice, mighty and courageous assembly, victorious regiment,
pillars of piety, warriors of Christ,
steadfast and invincible swordsmen,
truly divine, most mighty of mind and manly of soul,
holy choir desired of God, divinely elect company,
O ye forty martyrs equal in suffering,
equal also in character, and who received equal crowns://
entreat Christ, that He grant our souls peace and great mercy!

stichera.verse: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the psaltery and harp. (Ps. 150:3)
stichera.text:
Rejoice, victorious multitude, who were valorously courageous in battle,
ye stars who passed through fire and cold,
who broke asunder the water's ice,
who have rendered the earth heavenly and illumined all,
and who are now warmed in the bosom of Abraham,
having joined chorus with the armies of the angels.
O ye forty martyrs, flowers emitting the fragrance of spiritual diffusion://
entreat Christ, that He grant our souls great mercy.

doxastikon.text:
O passion-bearers of Christ, ye have rendered the most honorable Fast radiant
through the commemoration of your glorious suffering;
for, being forty in number, ye hallow the forty days of Lent,
emulating the Savior's suffering in your own suffering for Christ.
Wherefore, as ye are possessed of boldness,
pray that we in the world may attain unto the Resurrection on the third day,//
of God the Savior of our souls.
doxastikon.author: by John the Monk

theotokion.text:
We, the faithful bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos,
and we glorify thee as is meet,
for thou art the impregnable city, the impassable rampart,
the steadfast intercessor and refuge of our souls.
theotokion.label: Theotokion at Both now

troparionAfterDoxology.text:
By the pangs which Thy saints, suffered for Thee,
hearken unto us, O Lord,
and heal all our diseases,//
we beseech Thee, O Lover of mankind.
